text.tspan: SQS Standard queue: producers send, consumers poll, process, delete
A message (example: an order to process)
• order id, customer id, any attributes you want
• max size 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes); larger payloads: Extended
Client Library puts the body in S3 (up to 2 GB)
• unlimited throughput, unlimited messages in the queue
1. ReceiveMessage: up to 10 messages per call
2. Process (example: insert into an RDS database)
• consumers work in parallel; scale them horizontally
SQS + Auto Scaling Group: scale consumers on queue length
Patterns: SQS as a BUFFER to database writes (front end enqueues, workers dequeue and insert, so no transaction is lost under load)
and SQS to DECOUPLE tiers (web tier SendMessage → queue → back-end processing tier ReceiveMessage, each tier in its own ASG).
